No conflicts within my own lane, but three real cross-lane issues the integrator needs to resolve before more code stacks on top:

- **GameState shape is a confirmed contradiction, not just noted risk.** Codex A built `piles: [PileID:[Card]]`, which is the shape `DEC-project_plan-002` explicitly superseded (dictionary keyed by an enum-with-associated-values Codable-encodes as a flat unkeyed array). It's already load-bearing in 3 files (`RestoreIntegrityService`, `MoveValidation`, `StuckDetection` all do `state.piles[...]`/`for (pile, cards) in state.piles`) — Codex A flagged it too, so this converges. Integrator must pick the named-field struct now; every rewrite after this wave costs more.
- **`Card` vs `PlayCard` isn't just friction, it's a dead vocabulary that should be deleted, not reconciled.** `PlayCard` (stored `Int` id) is literally the option `DEC-tech_specs-001` rejected in favor of `Card`'s computed-`String` id. `GameEngine`/`Move`/`InteractionState`/`GameStateSnapshot` only ever reference `Card`/`PileID`/`GameState` — nothing downstream touches `PlayCard`, `PileType`, `BoardState`, `GameSnapshot`, `MoveAttempt`, or `TimerState`. Those are leftover pre-tech_specs draft types that made it into `DomainTypes.swift` alongside the real ones.
- **Concrete fallout of that split:** `DeckFactory`/`DeckShuffler` are entirely `PlayCard`-typed (matches interfaces.json's literal `DeckShuffler` signature) — there's no `Card`-based shuffle path at all. `GameEngine.newGame()` currently has nothing to call to produce a shuffled `[Card]` for a real `GameState`. This needs a `Card`-typed shuffler, not a `PlayCard→Card` adapter bolted on after.
- Codex B's `AtomicFileWriter`/`FileStorage` are fine standalone, but `GameSaveStore`'s next-wave work inherits whichever `GameState` shape wins issue #1 — sequencing matters, that store shouldn't start until it's locked.
- Claude B's `LaunchBackground` color sync to `Theme.Colors.light/dark.surfaceBase` is correct and matches my actual `Theme.swift` values exactly — no conflict there.
- No folder collisions: Claude B's `Domain/README.md` and `Features/Game|Stats|Settings/` skeleton sit cleanly alongside Codex A's real files and are exactly where my next-wave `GameView`/`StatsView`/`SettingsView` will land.
- Nothing for primary_ui to safely build against `GameEngine`/board piles yet — the `game.tableau.column0.topCard` / `game.foundation.hearts` flow tokens depend directly on which pile shape wins, so I'm blocked on #1 before writing real `GameView` pile-rendering code.
